entities.summary: Charles Henry Gordon Lennox, 11th Duke of Richmond, 11th Duke of Lennox, 11th Duke of Aubigny, 6th Duke of Gordon,, styled Lord Settrington until 1989 and then Earl of March and Kinrara until 2017, is a British aristocrat and owner of the Goodwood Estate in Sussex. He is the founder of the Goodwood Festival of Speed and the Goodwood Revival.
